verdicts.reason: A and B are essentially the same layout, and both have the same problems. The photo is badly cropped and blurry from upscaling. The translucent panel that kept the text readable in the original has nearly disappeared, so the dark headline and the small italic 'Save your money' copy sit on busy, low-contrast skyline. The chevrons float loose on the right instead of framing the text, and the text block is pinned near the top-centre with no intentional placement for the wide format. B's text is shifted by only a few pixels, which isn't enough to separate them.
